# Campus Bite - Vite HTML Project

## Project Overview
A modern HTML website project built with Vite bundler, providing fast development and optimized production builds.

## Setup Complete ✓

- [x] Project requirements clarified (Vite with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS)
- [x] Project scaffolding (Vite vanilla template)
- [x] Dependency installation (npm packages installed)
- [x] README.md created with full documentation
- [x] Project ready for development

## Quick Commands

**Start development server:**
```bash
npm run dev
```

**Build for production:**
```bash
npm run build
```

**Preview production build:**
```bash
npm run preview
```

## Project Files

- `src/main.js` - JavaScript entry point
- `src/style.css` - Global styles  
- `src/counter.js` - Sample component
- `index.html` - Main HTML file
- `public/` - Static assets directory

See README.md for complete documentation.
